name: Amber Autonomous API
tagline: Submit a multi-step goal. Amber works in the cloud and returns a verified result.

relatedProduct.name: AmberOne Wrap API
relatedProduct.note: Separate product — site-to-app packaging. Do not confuse with /api/v1/autonomous/jobs.

shortDescription: POST a goal, get a job ID, poll until Amber completes a verified multi-step result in the cloud.
longDescription: Amber Autonomous API queues multi-step goals. A cloud worker plans, resolves credentials (presence/last4 only), runs tools, recovers, verifies, and completes. Separate from the AmberOne Wrap API.
authentication: Bearer token (also accepts X-API-Key). Keys wrap_live_ / wrap_test_. Scope autonomous or full.
sandbox: Keys prefixed wrap_test_ run the full pipeline and never consume paid autonomous quota.
pricingNote: Sellable path is AmberOne Starter ($79) / Growth ($249) with autonomousJobsPerPeriod 15 / 60. Standalone tiers below are recommended catalog only until owner activates live Stripe prices.
